title: 自然语言驱动的眼控界面生成
summary: 用自然语言（文字或语音）描述需求，组合眼控交互方式生成网页界面，并通过试用反馈调整交互参数。
summary_en: Generates gaze-operable web interfaces from voice or text requests, combining interaction techniques and refining parameters through user feedback.
purpose: 探索如何把眼控交互知识转化为可组合的界面组件，服务于交互演示、教学和原型试用。
purpose_en: Explores how gaze-interaction knowledge can become composable interface components for demonstrations, teaching, and prototype trials.
features: 自然语言生成界面，选择并配置眼控交互方式。
Generate interfaces from natural language and configure gaze interaction techniques.
接入眼动设备数据，也支持鼠标模拟与轨迹回放。
Use live eye-tracker data, mouse simulation, or recorded gaze playback.
记录交互过程，辅助调试、试用反馈和后续分析。
Record interaction sessions for debugging, feedback, and later analysis.
contributions: 设计眼控交互组件、参数表达及界面生成流程。
Designed gaze-interaction components, parameter representations, and the interface-generation workflow.
实现原型界面、输入接入、轨迹录制与回放工具。
Implemented the prototype interface, input integration, and gaze recording and playback tools.
progress: 已建立界面生成原型、交互示例及会话记录模块。
Built an interface-generation prototype, interaction examples, and session-recording modules.
当前继续改进组件表达、生成界面质量和眼控使用体验。
Iterating on component expressiveness, generated layouts, and gaze usability.
教学部署与系统性用户评估仍属于后续工作。
Teaching deployment and systematic user evaluation remain future work.
相关发明专利申请于 2026 年 10 月获受理，当前待公开。
The related invention patent application was accepted for filing in October 2026 and is awaiting publication.

title: 头戴式眼动追踪系统
summary: 围绕近红外眼部成像、瞳孔检测与注视校准，开发头戴式眼动追踪的采集、算法和评估工具。
summary_en: Develops acquisition, algorithms, and evaluation tools for head-mounted eye tracking, covering infrared eye imaging, pupil detection, and gaze calibration.
purpose: 构建可调整的眼动研究平台，连接硬件、视觉算法与数据分析流程，为后续交互研究提供基础。
purpose_en: Builds an adaptable research platform connecting hardware, vision algorithms, and data analysis for gaze-interaction research.
features: 采集近红外眼部图像，支撑瞳孔检测与追踪算法开发。
Capture infrared eye imagery for pupil detection and tracking development.
组织模型训练、推理、误差分析与结果可视化流程。
Support model training, inference, error analysis, and result visualization.
开展注视校准及数据采集工具的开发与集成。
Develop and integrate gaze-calibration and data-acquisition tools.
contributions: 负责硬件与算法研发，将采集需求转化为实验和系统实现。
Lead hardware and algorithm development, translating acquisition requirements into experiments and system implementation.
构建瞳孔检测基线、训练评估脚本与结果分析工具。
Built pupil-detection baselines, training and evaluation scripts, and result-analysis tools.
progress: 已积累训练、推理与评估脚本，以及多轮算法可视化和失败案例分析。
Developed training, inference, and evaluation scripts, with multiple rounds of visual inspection and failure analysis.
持续改进不同成像条件下的检测稳定性，并推进采集与校准流程集成。
Continuing to improve detection robustness across imaging conditions and integrate acquisition and calibration workflows.
目前为研发中的研究系统，尚不作为完成性能验证的通用眼动产品。
An ongoing research system; general-purpose product performance has not been established.

title: 可编程人工眼台架
summary: 通过可控眼球转动与眼睑动作，探索用于眼动设备调试和重复测试的人工眼台架。
summary_en: Explores a programmable artificial-eye rig with controlled eye and eyelid movements for eye-tracker debugging and repeatable engineering tests.
purpose: 为眼动设备研发提供可编程测试对象，减少调试时对真人眼部运动的依赖。机构基于 Will Cogley 的 EyeMech 项目扩展。
purpose_en: Provides a programmable test object for eye-tracker development, reducing reliance on human eye movements during debugging. The mechanism builds on Will Cogley’s EyeMech project.
features: 控制眼球水平、垂直转动与眼睑动作，切换不同调试模式。
Control horizontal and vertical eye rotation and eyelid movement across debugging modes.
通过固件、仿真和网页控制界面检查控制链路与状态。
Inspect the control pipeline and status through firmware, simulation, and a web console.
面向后续可编程轨迹与重复测试流程预留扩展。
Prepare for programmable trajectories and repeatable test workflows.
contributions: 结合眼动设备测试需求设计台架路线、控制方案与硬件选型。
Defined the rig approach, control architecture, and hardware choices around eye-tracker testing needs.
在既有机构基础上开发控制固件、状态反馈、仿真与网页调试工具。
Developed control firmware, status feedback, simulation, and web debugging tools around an existing mechanism.
progress: 已有控制固件与仿真原型，并建立网页控制界面。
Control firmware and simulation prototypes are available, along with a web console.
实物集成、可重复性评估和外部反馈测量仍需推进。
Physical integration, repeatability assessment, and external feedback measurement remain in progress.
现阶段定位为工程调试原型；舵机指令角不作为眼球角度真值。
Currently an engineering-debugging prototype; commanded servo angles are not treated as ground-truth eye angles.
